d:
The BRICS Summit was called a failure by many—but was it really?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu go beyond viral clips about food, lighting and social media controversies to examine the real geopolitical outcomes of the BRICS Summit 2026. From the India–China reset and renewed diplomatic engagement to discussions around de-dollarisation, local currency trade, AI cooperation and the idea of a multipolar world, we break down the developments that actually matter.
